name: Disk Detainer Picking
description: Disk detainer locks use rotating disks rather than pin stacks and are common in medium-to-high security padlocks and some deadbolts. Dedicated disk detainer picks rotate each disk individually to the correct position while applying rotational tension. These locks require a completely different technique and tool set from pin tumbler picking and represent a meaningful skill investment beyond the core picking curriculum.

blue.det: Specialized pick visible at disk detainer keyway; time at lock.
blue.cm: High-security disk detainer cylinders; limited availability of quality picks reduces risk; use electronic access for high-security applications instead of disk detainer locks.
